statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The diagnosis codes listed were R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code was CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered.
The procedure is medically necessary to correlate the reported palpitations and dizziness with potential arrhythmic activity.
